messages:
maya: Heads-up: rolling release tonight 02:00 UTC. Services involved: api/runtime/console/router. Plan: pin versions, 2%->20%->100% canary. Any blockers?

frank: API ack. Note: rate-limit header behavior changed in api@v1.13.0 — tested in staging.

hao: Runtime ack. runtime@v2.5.0 has kernel tweak. We will keep runtime@v2.4.8 as emergency fallback.

riley: Console ack. Release notes queued. No UI flags.

maya: @deploy-bot create canary run with pins api@v1.13.0 runtime@v2.5.0 console@v0.9.3 router@v3.2.1. Thresholds: errors>0.75% or p95>baseline+250ms. Start in 15m.

deploy-bot: Created run id=canary-20240315-02; scheduled start 2024-03-15T02:15:00Z; policy 2%->20%->100%; thresholds errors>0.75% || p95>baseline+250ms.

hao: small tweak: 2% slice error threshold -> 1% to avoid noisy aborts. Approve?

ops: Observability preflight done. I own rollback authority until 03:30 UTC. Synthetic checks in place.

maya: Approved. Keep router header split OFF until 20% as a conservative measure.

deploy-bot: Canary started; 2% slice in flight. Monitoring hooks enabled.

deploy-bot: Metrics update: error_rate=0.05%, p95=195ms (baseline 190ms). Good to scale to 20%.

ops: No SLO hits. Proceed to 20%.

deploy-bot: Scaled to 20% 1: metrics stable. Next auto-step to 100% in 10m if green.

frank: Staying on-call for 30m. Will run rollback approval if ops asks.

ops: All green. I'll signal before 100%.

maya: Thanks. Leave rollback plan here: `/deploy rollback --run-id canary-20240315-02 --to-tag stable-20240301 --services api,runtime,console,router`

deploy-bot: Canary healthy at 20% after 10m. Scheduled 100% shift in 5m.

riley: Ready to cut console flags after 100% completes.

ops: Final gate: proceeding to 100%. I'll hold rollback authority until 03:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 100% 1: run complete. No rollback triggered.

maya: Closing thread. Will post final release note with pinned versions and fallback info.
